name: Rage
description: Bonus action: start a rage. The perks below apply only while you are out of heavy armor. You get advantage on Strength checks and saves, extra damage (the Rage Damage bonus) on melee weapon attacks made with Strength, and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage.
No casting spells and no concentrating on them while raging.

A rage lasts 1 minute. It stops sooner if you are knocked out, or if your turn ends having neither attacked a hostile creature nor taken damage since your previous turn. You may also drop it with a bonus action.

name: Reckless Attack
trigger: Your first attack on your turn
description: On the first attack of your turn you may go reckless. Your Strength melee weapon attacks have advantage until the turn ends.
In return, enemies have advantage on their attacks against you until your next turn starts.

name: Relentless Rage
trigger: You drop to 0 hit points while raging
uses: DC 10, +5 each use until a short or long rest
description: Dropping to 0 HP while raging (without being killed outright) lets you roll a Constitution save at DC 10. Succeed and you stay up with 1 HP.
Every later use adds 5 to the DC. A short or long rest resets it to 10.

name: Frenzy
trigger: While raging in a frenzy
description: Opt into frenzy as you start a rage. For its whole length, each later turn lets you spend a bonus action on 1 melee weapon attack.
When the rage ends, you take 1 level of exhaustion.

name: Intimidating Presence
description: Target one creature within 30 ft that can see or hear you. It makes a Wisdom save against DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier, or becomes frightened of you, lasting through your next turn.
Spend your action on later turns to extend the fear another round. It stops if the target loses line of sight to you or ends a turn over 60 ft away.
A target that passes the save is immune to this for 24 hours.

name: Retaliation
trigger: You take damage from a creature within 5 ft
description: When a creature within 5 ft damages you, make 1 melee weapon attack against it as a reaction.

name: Spirit Seeker
description: You can cast beast sense and speak with animals, but only as rituals (they take extra time and use no spell slot).

name: Totem Spirit
trigger: While raging
description: Pick a totem animal when you take this path. Its effect works only while you rage.
Bear: resistance to every damage type except psychic.
Eagle: while you wear no heavy armor, opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage, and you can Dash as a bonus action.
Wolf: allies have advantage on melee attacks against any enemy within 5 ft of you.

name: Spirit Walker
description: You can cast commune with nature as a ritual. A spirit version of one of your totem animals appears to deliver the answers.

name: Totemic Attunement
trigger: While raging
description: Pick a totem animal again (the same one or a new one). Its effect works only while you rage.
Bear: hostile creatures within 5 ft of you attack at disadvantage unless they target you or an ally with this same feature. Enemies that cannot see or hear you, or cannot be frightened, are immune.
Eagle: you fly at a speed matching your current walking speed, but only in short bursts. Land before your turn ends or you drop.
Wolf (bonus action): after a melee weapon hit on a target no bigger than Large, spend a bonus action to topple it prone.

name: Bear
description: While you rage, you resist every damage type except psychic. The bear spirit lets you shrug off nearly any punishment.

name: Eagle
trigger: Raging, out of heavy armor
description: During a rage without heavy armor on, Dash costs you only a bonus action on your turn, and any opportunity attack made at you rolls with disadvantage.

name: Wolf
description: While you rage, allies who attack in melee get advantage against any enemy standing within 5 feet of you. You lead the pack.

name: Elk
description: While you rage without heavy armor on, your walking speed rises by 15 ft.

name: Tiger
description: While you rage, your long jump grows by 10 ft and your high jump by 3 ft.

name: Bear
description: Bear might: your carrying capacity, maximum load and maximum lift all double. You also roll Strength checks to push, pull, lift or break objects with advantage.

name: Eagle
description: You see like an eagle: distance up to 1 mile is clear to you, and within 100 feet you can pick out fine details. Dim light no longer penalizes your Wisdom (Perception) checks.

name: Wolf
description: You get a wolf's hunting senses. You can track creatures while moving at a fast pace, and you can sneak at a normal pace while traveling.

name: Elk
description: Your travel pace doubles, mounted or on foot, as does the pace of up to ten companions within 60 ft of you while you are not incapacitated.

name: Tiger
description: Gain proficiency in two skills of your choice from Athletics, Acrobatics, Stealth and Survival.

name: Bear
description: While you rage, enemies within 5 feet of you have disadvantage when attacking anyone besides you or an ally with this feature. Enemies that cannot see or hear you, or cannot be frightened, ignore this.

name: Eagle
description: While you rage, you gain a flying speed matching your current walking speed. It lasts only in short bursts: you fall if your turn ends while you are airborne with nothing holding you up.

name: Wolf
trigger: Raging, after a melee weapon hit
description: A rage-only takedown: once your melee weapon attack connects with a Large or smaller creature, a bonus action that same turn drops it prone.

name: Elk
trigger: Raging, moving through a Large or smaller creature
description: Raging, you can spend a bonus action mid-move to run through a Large or smaller creature. It rolls a Strength save, DC 8 + Strength modifier + proficiency bonus. Failing, it drops prone and takes 1d12 + your Strength modifier bludgeoning.

name: Tiger
trigger: Raging, after a 20 ft straight charge
description: Raging, after you charge 20 ft or more straight at a Large or smaller target and just before you swing at it, a bonus action buys one extra melee weapon attack on it.

name: Magic Awareness
description: Action: until your next turn ends, you sense where every spell and magic item within 60 ft of you is, unless it has total cover. For each spell sensed you also learn its school.

name: Wild Surge
trigger: You enter your rage
description: Each time you start a rage, roll a d8 on the Wild Magic table for the effect you get. Where an effect calls for a save, its DC is 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier.
1: Every creature you choose that you can see within 30 ft makes a Constitution save or takes 1d12 necrotic damage. You gain 1d12 temporary hit points.
2: Teleport into an unoccupied space you can see, up to 30 ft away. Until the rage ends, you can repeat this with a bonus action on each of your turns.

3: An intangible spirit (in the shape of a flumph or pixie, your pick) appears within 5 ft of a creature you can see within 30 ft. As the turn ends it bursts, and creatures no more than 5 ft from it make Dexterity saves or take 1d6 force damage. Until the rage ends, a bonus action on each of your turns calls up a new one.

4: A weapon you hold deals force damage until the rage ends and gains the light and thrown properties (normal range 20 ft, long range 60 ft). If it leaves your hand, it is back in it as the turn ends.
5: Until the rage ends, any creature that hits you with an attack roll takes 1d6 force damage.
6: Until the rage ends, glowing lights give you +1 AC, and allies within 10 ft of you get the same bonus.
7: Until the rage ends, your enemies treat the ground within 15 ft of you as difficult terrain.

8: Light blasts from you at a creature you choose that you can see within 30 ft: it makes a Constitution save or takes 1d6 radiant damage and is blinded until your next turn starts. Until the rage ends, you can repeat this with a bonus action on each of your turns.

name: Bolstering Magic
description: Action: touch a creature (it can be you) and give it one of these benefits:
• For 10 minutes, it adds a d3 to every attack roll and ability check it makes.
• It rolls a d3 and recovers one spent spell slot of that level or lower (its pick). A creature that gets this benefit can't get it again until it finishes a long rest.

name: Unstable Backlash
trigger: You are raging and take damage or fail a save
description: Right after it happens, you can spend your reaction on a fresh Wild Magic roll. Its effect happens at once and replaces the one you had.

name: Controlled Surge
trigger: You roll on the Wild Magic table
description: Roll the die twice and pick which of the two effects happens. If both dice show the same number, ignore it and choose any effect on the table.

name: Giant's Havoc
trigger: You enter your rage
description: For as long as a rage lasts, you get both benefits below.
Crushing Throw: when a ranged attack you make with a thrown weapon hits and uses Strength, add your Rage Damage bonus to its damage.
Giant Stature: you gain 5 ft of extra reach. If you're smaller than Large, you and the gear you wear grow to Large, unless there isn't space for it, in which case your size stays the same.
Level 14 (Demiurgic Colossus): the extra reach becomes 10 ft, and you can grow to Large or Huge (your pick).

name: Elemental Cleaver
trigger: You enter your rage
description: As a rage starts, infuse one weapon you hold with acid, cold, fire, thunder or lightning (your pick). While you wield it during the rage, its damage becomes that type, each hit adds 1d6 damage of that type, and it becomes a thrown weapon (normal range 20 ft, long range 60 ft). Thrown, it returns to your hand right after it hits or misses. Its benefits stop working while anyone else wields it.
While raging and holding it, you can switch it to another of those damage types with a bonus action.
Level 14 (Demiurgic Colossus): the extra damage becomes 2d6.

name: Mighty Impel
trigger: While raging
description: Bonus action: grab a creature no bigger than Medium that is within your reach and hurl it into an unoccupied space you can see, up to 30 ft from you. If it is unwilling, it makes a Strength save (DC 8 + your Strength modifier + your proficiency bonus) and stays put on a success.
If it lands with no surface or liquid beneath it that can hold it, it drops, takes falling damage as usual and ends up prone.
Level 14 (Demiurgic Colossus): it works on Large or smaller creatures. Your rages also add 10 ft to your reach and can make you Large or Huge (your pick).

name: Druidcraft
description: Take druidcraft as your Giant's Power cantrip, with Wisdom as its spellcasting ability. The same feature also teaches you Giant (or another language, if you already know Giant).

name: Thaumaturgy
description: Take thaumaturgy as your Giant's Power cantrip, with Wisdom as its spellcasting ability. The same feature also teaches you Giant (or another language, if you already know Giant).

name: Ancestral Protectors
trigger: Your first hit on a creature during your turn while raging
description: Spectral warriors answer your rage. On each of your turns while it lasts, they mark the first target your attacks hit, and the mark holds until your next turn starts.
The marked creature has disadvantage on attack rolls aimed at anyone except you, and any other creature it hits resists that attack's damage. The mark also ends if your rage ends.

name: Spirit Shield
trigger: While raging, another creature no more than 30 ft away that you can see takes damage
description: Spend your reaction to have your guardian spirits shield that creature: roll 2d6 and take the result off the damage.
The reduction grows to 3d6 at barbarian level 10 and 4d6 at level 14.

name: Consult the Spirits
uses: Once per short or long rest

spells.uses: No slot or material; once per short or long rest
No slot or material; once per short or long rest

description: Cast augury or clairvoyance without a spell slot or material components. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for them.
Your clairvoyance makes no sensor: instead, one of your ancestral spirits goes, unseen, to the place you picked.
Once you cast either spell this way, finish a short or long rest before doing it again.

name: Vengeful Ancestors
trigger: Your Spirit Shield reduces the damage of an attack
description: Your ancestors strike back: the attacker takes force damage equal to the damage your Spirit Shield prevented.

name: Desert
trigger: You enter your rage, or later turns of it (bonus action)
description: While you rage, a stormy aura reaches 10 ft from you in all directions (total cover blocks it). Its effect fires as the rage starts, and on each later turn of that rage you can fire it again with a bonus action. Its save DC is 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus. Each time you gain a barbarian level you may switch to another environment.
Desert: each time the effect fires, every other creature inside the aura takes 2 fire damage. This rises to 3 at barbarian level 5, 4 at level 10, 5 at level 15 and 6 at level 20.
Level 6 (Storm Soul): you resist fire damage and shrug off extreme heat. You can also use your action to set fire to a flammable object you touch, provided nobody else is wearing or carrying it.
Level 10 (Shielding Storm): creatures you choose also resist fire damage while they are in your aura.

name: Sea
trigger: You enter your rage, or later turns of it (bonus action)
description: While you rage, a stormy aura reaches 10 ft from you in all directions (total cover blocks it). Its effect fires as the rage starts, and on each later turn of that rage you can fire it again with a bonus action. Its save DC is 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus. Each time you gain a barbarian level you may switch to another environment.

Sea: each time the effect fires, pick one other creature in the aura that you can see. It makes a Dexterity save, taking 1d6 lightning damage if it fails or half that if it succeeds. The damage becomes 2d6 at barbarian level 10, 3d6 at level 15 and 4d6 at level 20.
Level 6 (Storm Soul): you resist lightning damage, can breathe underwater and swim at a speed of 30 ft.
Level 10 (Shielding Storm): creatures you choose also resist lightning damage while they are in your aura.

name: Tundra
trigger: You enter your rage, or later turns of it (bonus action)
description: While you rage, a stormy aura reaches 10 ft from you in all directions (total cover blocks it). Its effect fires as the rage starts, and on each later turn of that rage you can fire it again with a bonus action. Its save DC is 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus. Each time you gain a barbarian level you may switch to another environment.
Tundra: each time the effect fires, creatures you choose inside the aura gain 2 temporary hit points. This rises to 3 at barbarian level 5, 4 at level 10, 5 at level 15 and 6 at level 20.

Level 6 (Storm Soul): you resist cold damage and shrug off extreme cold. You can also use your action to turn a 5-ft cube of water you touch into ice. The ice thaws after 1 minute. You can't do it while a creature is inside that cube.
Level 10 (Shielding Storm): creatures you choose also resist cold damage while they are in your aura.

Level 14 (Raging Storm): whenever the effect fires, you can pick one creature in the aura that you can see. Unless it passes a Strength save, magical frost drops its speed to 0 until your next turn starts.

name: Raging Storm (Desert)
trigger: A creature in your desert Storm Aura hits you with an attack
description: Lash back the moment the hit lands: the attacker rolls a Dexterity save. On a failure, half your barbarian level is dealt to it as fire damage.

name: Raging Storm (Sea)
trigger: You hit a creature in your sea Storm Aura with an attack
description: The creature you hit rolls a Strength save. If it fails, the surge of the storm knocks it prone.

name: Divine Fury
trigger: Your first weapon hit on each of your turns while raging
description: While you rage, the first creature your weapon attacks hit on each of your turns also takes 1d6 + half your barbarian level in extra damage.
The damage is necrotic or radiant; you pick one of the two when you gain this feature.

name: Fanatical Focus
trigger: You fail a saving throw while raging
description: Roll the failed save again. You must keep the new result.

name: Zealous Presence
description: Bonus action: let loose a battle cry charged with divine power. Choose up to 10 other creatures no more than 60 ft away that can hear it; until your next turn starts, they have advantage on attack rolls and saving throws.

name: Instinctive Pounce
trigger: You use your bonus action to start a rage
description: Starting a rage comes with a leap forward: as part of that same bonus action, you may move up to half your speed.

name: Form of the Beast
trigger: You enter your rage
description: Each time you rage you can grow one natural weapon, which lasts until the rage ends. You treat it as a simple melee weapon and add your Strength modifier to its attack and damage rolls. Pick the form each rage:
Bite: 1d8 piercing. Once per turn, if your bite damages a creature while you are below half your hit points, you regain hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.
Claws: 1d6 slashing, one per empty hand. Once per turn, when you attack with a claw as part of the Attack action, that action gives you one more claw attack.
Tail: 1d8 piercing, with reach. It also unlocks the Form of the Beast (Tail) reaction.
Level 6 (Bestial Soul): they count as magical when overcoming resistance or immunity to nonmagical damage.

name: Form of the Beast (Tail)
trigger: Your tail is out and a creature you can see no more than 10 ft away hits you with an attack roll
description: Lash out with the tail: roll a d8 and add the result to your AC against that attack, which can turn the hit into a miss.

name: Bestial Soul
trigger: You finish a short or long rest
description: Pick one adaptation; it holds until the end of your next short or long rest:
Swim: swim speed matching your walking speed; you can also breathe underwater.
Climb: climb speed matching your walking speed. You scale difficult surfaces, upside down across ceilings included, with no ability check.
Jump: when you jump, make a Strength (Athletics) check and add its total, in feet, to the distance. Only once per turn.

name: Infectious Fury
trigger: Your natural weapon hits a creature while you rage
description: The target makes a Wisdom save (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier). If it fails, you pick one effect:
• It spends its reaction attacking, in melee, another creature you can see that you choose.
• It takes 2d12 psychic damage.

name: Call the Hunt
trigger: You enter your rage
description: Pick other willing creatures in sight and within 30 ft, up to your Constitution modifier (minimum 1). For each one that accepts, you gain 5 temporary hit points.
Until the rage ends, each chosen creature, once on each of its turns, can roll a d6 and add it to the damage when its attack roll hits and damages a target.

name: Battlerager Armor
trigger: Raging in spiked armor
description: Spiked armor counts as a weapon in your hands.
While you rage in spiked armor, use a bonus action for one melee attack with the spikes against a target within 5 ft. Roll with Strength; a hit deals 1d4 piercing.
Rider: when your grapple check succeeds on a grapple made with the Attack action, the target also takes 3 piercing.
Needs spiked armor (rare medium armor, 75 gp). The book limits this path to dwarves unless your DM lifts that.

name: Reckless Abandon
trigger: You use Reckless Attack while raging
description: Using Reckless Attack during a rage also grants temporary HP equal to your Constitution modifier (at least 1).
Any that remain vanish when the rage ends.

name: Battlerager Charge
trigger: Raging
description: While you rage, Dash costs you a bonus action instead of your action.

name: Spiked Retribution
trigger: A creature within 5 ft hits you in melee
description: A creature within 5 ft that hits you with a melee attack takes 3 piercing damage.
Works only while you rage, are not incapacitated, and wear spiked armor.
